name: Jangan town (TOWN_LIFE §7.6; WAVE_PLAN7 TL-B phase 2)
scope: What a player sees at the plaza and the market from the ground that has no remaster set yet: 8 paving and street tiles; the plaza ensemble (the new fountain basin's cj_jang_pondfen; DRAGON-INT replaced the retail statue and the pond lattice, cj_jang_dragon and cj_jang_pondfen02, with remastered models on Medium+, content/remaster/models.json); the portal; the restaurant awning; the shop fronts, signs and roofs around the plaza (acce, armo, weapon, etc, luxury, stable). run: pnpm texpipe run --set all --detail, with one --key <entry> per entry of keys; on the GPU queue (work/tools/gpu.lock); ComfyUI only via work/tools/comfyui/start_comfyui.sh for the 8 SDXL tiles (stop_comfyui.sh after); then the review page and the before/after shots of the plaza for the user
